Class Weapon

java.lang.Object
entity.Entity
entity.weapon.Weapon
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObject, Renderable, Updatable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bible, Blue, Cleave, Dismantle, Infinity, Lazer, MaximumBlue, MaximumCleave, MaximumDismantle, MaximumOutputInfinity, MaximumRed, Red, Standard
public abstract class Weapon extends Entity implements Updatable, Renderable
Abstract base class for all weapons in the game.

A weapon has three distinct lifecycle phases each game frame:

  1. use(double) — called every frame while the weapon is equipped; the weapon decides internally when to actually fire based on its cooldown.
  2. update(double) — called on every active projectile / effect that was spawned by use(); the projectile moves, deals damage, etc.
  3. render(GraphicsContext) — draws the projectile / effect on screen.

Weapons support a level system (1 … maxLevel). Once the level reaches maxLevel, getLevel() returns "Max" instead of a numeric string. Each concrete subclass must implement upgrade() to apply its own stat changes when the player levels up the weapon.

The getCooldownProgress() helper is used by the UI to drive the cooldown overlay in ItemSquare.

  • Field Details

    • level

      protected int level
      Current level of the weapon (1-based). Protected so that concrete subclasses such as evolved weapons can read the level directly; external code should use getLevel().

    • timeSinceUse

      protected double timeSinceUse
      Seconds elapsed since the weapon was last fired.

      Each concrete weapon is responsible for incrementing this counter in its use(double) implementation and resetting it to zero when the weapon fires. Stored in the base class so the UI can read cooldown progress through getCooldownProgress() without knowing the concrete subclass.

  • Method Details

    • getCooldownProgress

      public double getCooldownProgress()
      Returns the fraction of the cooldown that has elapsed, clamped to [0, 1].

      A value of 1.0 means the weapon is ready to fire; values below 1.0 indicate it is still cooling down. Weapons with a cooldown of zero or less always return 1.0 (never blocked by cooldown).

      Used by ItemSquare.tickCooldown(Weapon) to animate the cooldown overlay on the HUD.

      Returns:
      cooldown progress in [0, 1]

    • use

      public abstract void use(double accumulateDeltaTime)
      Ticks the weapon each game frame while it is in the equipped weapon slot.

      Implementations should increment timeSinceUse by accumulateDeltaTime and fire (spawning a projectile in GameManager.getUsingWeaponList()) when the cooldown elapses.

      Parameters:
      accumulateDeltaTime - seconds since the last frame

    • update

      public abstract void update(double accumulateDeltaTime)
      Advances the state of an active projectile / effect that was already spawned.

      After use(double) creates and adds a weapon instance to usingWeaponList, the game loop calls update() on it every frame until isExpired() returns true.

      Specified by:
      update in interface Updatable
      Parameters:
      accumulateDeltaTime - seconds since the last frame
